# Switch NX2 - read when the Bouquet GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\bouquet\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/bouquet/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread (SPLIT=2 delivers up to +54% FPS alone).
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# 90-220 MB/s of buffers CPU never touches, causing heavy mutex contention and dropping FPS by ~38-63%.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Paces frame submission 2 frames ahead. Reduces frametime spikes, but adds ~1-2 frames of input latency.
# Enable only if frame pacing stability is preferred over responsive controls.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=2

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1

# --- Bouquet: optimizations ported from other forks (on by default; uncomment a line to undo it) ---
# Selevet: semaphore acquires already met in memory don't drain the GPU thread (off in DK Bananza)
#EDEN_NX2_ACQUIRE_PEEK=0
# Selevet: acquires met by a release still queued for the GPU thread don't drain
#EDEN_NX2_ACQUIRE_QUEUED=0
# Selevet: SEM_EXECUTE acquires release fences on the back thread instead of draining
#EDEN_NX2_SEMEXEC_DRAIN=1
# Selevet: poll the host GPU up to 300 us before sleeping in the driver
#EDEN_NX2_GPU_WAIT_SPIN_US=0
# Selevet: high process priority (Windows)
#EDEN_NX2_HIGH_PRIORITY=0
# Selevet: tell the Switch 2 SDK the display supports VRR (steadier game speed)
#EDEN_NX2_REPORT_VRR=0
# Orchid / Eglantine-DKB: skip unchanged vertex buffer checks
#EDEN_NX2_DRAW_TUNING=0
# Eglantine-DKB: skip draws with no vertices or no instances
#EDEN_NX2_DRAW_EMPTY=1
# Eglantine-DKB (DK Bananza only): macro DMA reads of untouched pages skip the full drain
#EDEN_NX2_DMA_DRAIN=1
# Opt-in: skip small Switch 2 draws while their pipeline builds (less stutter, maybe missing effects)
#EDEN_NX2_ASYNC_SKIP=1
